answer_1.quote: Graph-to-text (G2T) generation and text-to-graph (T2G) triple extraction are two mutually inverse tasks that are crucial to the domain of knowledge graphs (KGs). G2T verbalizes the structural information in KG with descriptive texts, which has attracted much attention to expand the application scope of KG, such as KG-based dialogue and Q&A system.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text sequences from knowledge subgraphs

answer_2.quote: For G2T, we adopt several widely used automatic metrics, i.e., BLEU , Meteor , and CIDEr . BLEU and Meteor consider precision, recall, or F-score between generated and ground truth texts while CIDEr calculates the TF-IDF weights for each n-gram. For T2G, we use the micro F1 score to evaluate the quality of the generated triples.
